parameters.name: FileKey
parameters.description:
The FileKey used to upload the file.
> Format: HONEYPOT_FILE/{timestamp}_{custom_file_name}.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The name of the uploaded file.

parameters.name: HoneypotImageName
parameters.description: The name of the honeypot image.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The ID of the honeypot management node.
> Call the [ListHoneypotNode](~~ListHoneypotNode~~) operation to obtain this value.

parameters.name: TemplateExtra
parameters.description: The template prompt corresponding to the uploaded file.
